title: Longest login streak
statement:
Table logins(user TEXT, day TEXT), where day is a date as YYYY-MM-DD. A user can log in several times on the same day.

For every user, return the user and the length of their longest run of consecutive days with at least one login. Sort by streak length, longest first, then by user.

Hint: SQLite's date() and julianday() functions work on YYYY-MM-DD text.

scenarios.name: Example
scenarios.input:
CREATE TABLE logins (user TEXT, day TEXT);  -- day is YYYY-MM-DD; a user can log in several times a day
INSERT INTO logins (user, day) VALUES
  ('amina', '2026-03-01'),
  ('amina', '2026-03-02'),
  ('amina', '2026-03-03'),
  ('amina', '2026-03-05'),
  ('bilal', '2026-03-01'),
  ('bilal', '2026-03-03');
